item.title: AAA Fest: Veracity Presents
item.description: *The Vera Project and Veracity Present* Jackie Tulsa Aurora Ave Silvertooth Sarya \----- **Always All Ages** : Celebrating 25 years of always all-ages music, art, and community at The Vera Project and Black Lodge with a week of FREE shows and classes. Featuring two and a half decades of the bands, artists, organizers, educators, and friends that have helped keep the lights on and music loud at VERA since 2001. \----- VERA is fighting for the future of our local, independent music scene and underground culture, building community outside of profit. We’re offering a more meaningful way to support live music, artists, culture bearers, social movements, and young people than the increasingly brutal realities of Seattle’s status quo. We can have the music community we need if we work together to build it. **Learn more at https://theveraproject.org/vera25** Presented by The Vera Project. This is an All Ages event.
